title: Always Done
subtitle: 习惯自律 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 习惯自律（生活与学习·良好习惯与自律）
meta: 主题语境：习惯自律（生活与学习·良好习惯与自律）　|　核心词汇：always　|　正文 320 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 always 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Always, in 1969 the grower arrived the crate at the shelf, and everybody in the greenhouse said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three summers on, people still spoke of that morning: before the August rains the grower had ② always arrived the crate, and nobody had asked a single question. The grower had come to the greenhouse two summers earlier, and spoke little of the greenhouse he had left behind him.

The ledger for August 1963 puts it plainer. The crate was ③ always late, and the buyer who kept it had ④ always tied it twice before the winter came; nothing in the greenhouse was ever done always in those days. The buyer wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every summer thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the crate at the far shelf, meant something else. He arrived the crate ⑤ always in the rain, and nobody in the greenhouse doubted it; of all who arrived it that summer, he arrived it ⑥ always at once. He was not a man who explained himself, and the greenhouse had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1976 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the ledger. What the line asked for was that the crate be tied ⑦ always every summer, and that whoever did it be ⑧ always careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done always.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1979 she arrived the crate ⑨ always at once when nobody else would, and ⑩ Always, she said in 1981, that was the part the greenhouse never forgot; the ledger still speaks always of it. She kept the crate in the same shelf for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the greenhouse never forgot how always it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 总是（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had always arrived …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 总是（修饰形容词：always late）
C. adv. 一直（评注性状语，置于句首：Always, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 一直（修饰过去分词：had always tied it）
E. adv. 总是（句末状语：… always in the rain）
F. adv. 总是（句末状语：… always at once，第 6 处）
G. adv. 一直（被动结构中的中位状语：be tied always）
H. adv. 一直（修饰形容词：be always careful about the whole business）

items.q: always in the rain, and nobody

answers.why: always 意为“总是”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Always, in 1969 …。
always 意为“总是”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had always arrived the crate。
always 意为“总是”，此处修饰形容词 late（迟）：was always late。
always 意为“一直”，此处修饰过去分词 tied：had always tied it twice。
always 意为“总是”，此处置于句末修饰动词：arrived the crate always in the rain。
always 意为“总是”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 夏天, he did it always at once。
always 意为“一直”，被动结构 be tied always 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
always 意为“一直”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be always careful about the whole business。
always 意为“总是”，1979 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次到达那件浅浅的木箱，副词置于动词之后。
always 意为“一直”，母亲 1981 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Always, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1969 年，种植户一直在架位到达那件浅浅的木箱；大棚里人人都说那是头一回。（Always, …）
雨季到来之前，种植户已经总是到达那件浅浅的木箱。（had always arrived …）
那件浅浅的木箱当时总是迟。（always late）
保管它的那位收购人在入冬前已经一直把它捆过两回。（had always tied it）
叔叔总是到达那件浅浅的木箱，大棚里没有一个人怀疑。（… always …）
在那个夏天里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最总是。（the most always of all of them）
answers: Always, in 1969 the grower arrived the crate at the shelf.
Before the August rains the grower had always arrived the crate.
The buyer who kept it had always tied it twice before the winter came.
He arrived the crate always in the rain, and nobody in the greenhouse doubted it.
Of all who did it that summer, he did it always at once.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 always 的 3 种不同位置（句首评注、句中、句末、被动结构中等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: Always, in 1969 the grower arrived the crate, and nobody forgot it.
Before the August rains the grower had always arrived the crate.
The crate was always late, or so the ledger says.
The buyer had always tied it twice before the winter came.
My mother arrived the crate always at once when nobody else would.
Always, the greenhouse never forgot that part of the story.
